|quest_reward2_type = vendor |quest_reward2_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward2_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward2_act = 6 |quest_reward2_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Destructive Link''' is a [[Link skill]] that targets an allied player to apply a buff which links you to them for a duration. While linked, they use your [[critical strike chance]] for main hand [[hit]]s. If the target dies while linked, you will also die. This skill cannot be used by Totems, Traps, or Mines. ==Skill functions and interactions== This skill replaces the linked target's main hand critical strike chance with yours; this uses the value in the player's character sheet which is affected by modifiers to critical strike chance, not just the base critical strike chance of the weapon. {{il|Tecrod's Gaze}}, for example, will affect this value. The critical strike chance of the linked target cannot be further modified through stats on the linked target. For example, a linked player with {{il|Marylene's Fallacy}} will not have their critical strike chance lowered by the item. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Critical Strike
